revisions.goal: Prepare and deploy the eve 0.7.0 release from current main, including changelog/package version updates, verification, EVE release Snapshot, Git commits, tag, and push for release workflow deployment.
revisions.acceptanceCriteria: npm/eve package metadata is set to 0.7.0; CHANGELOG.md has a dated 0.7.0 section summarizing user-visible changes since 0.6.0; relevant local verification passes or any failures are recorded; implementation changes are committed; an EVE release Snapshot is recorded and committed; tag v0.7.0 is created and pushed to origin to trigger the release deployment.

milestones.title: Prepare release metadata
milestones.goal: Populate changelog and update npm package version to 0.7.0.

milestones.title: Verify release candidate
milestones.goal: Run the local verification suite relevant to the release.

milestones.title: Record and deploy
milestones.goal: Commit release metadata, record the EVE release Snapshot, commit the .eve record, tag v0.7.0, and push branch/tag.

revisions.configuredSuite: go test ./...; go test -run TestRunVersion ./cmd/eve with version injection; npm --prefix npm/eve test; npm --prefix npm/eve run pack:check; npm --prefix ui test; npm --prefix ui run build; npm --prefix site run build
